messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — I want to propose a hard holdback on three items for the upcoming public MVP: tenant SSO, advanced tenant-aware routing, and the embeddings-cache aggressive optimization. They’re coupling infra risk and adding rollout complexity. Can we agree to push to v1?
Shankar (Eng): +1 on risk surface. Embeddings-cache work is exposing some KV cache invalidation edge cases that affect tail latency. We don’t have a stable mitigation in prod yet.
Micah (Sales): Heads-up — two pilot customers are asking specifically for tenant SSO. They said it’s a blocker for broader adoption, but they’re ok being in a paid pilot if we can offer it earlier behind a controlled plan.
Jules (Design): If SSO is out, we need a clear fallback UX for pilots and public users. Suggestions: a dedicated "Enterprise sign-in (pilot)" banner + a clear account-level CTA. Don’t want users to hit broken flows.
Carla (PMM): Messaging angle: market MVP as "Core inference + predictable SLAs" and call out SSO + advanced routing as "Enterprise pilot features coming in v1". Keeps expectations aligned.
Anya (PM): Proposed compromise: ship with base auth (email/OAuth), enable tenant SSO only for Dedicated / private deployments and for invited pilots via feature flag. Move public-managed SSO and advanced routing to v1. This preserves pilot needs without risking public SLA. Thoughts?
Shankar (Eng): Feasible. Implementation: 1) feature flag gating for tenant SSO (per-tenant opt-in), 2) short canary on Dedicated nodes, 3) rollback path documented. I can scope the work as ~3 sprint-days for flag + safe rollout hooks.
Micah (Sales): That works for pilot customers. They want a clear timeline. Can we promise "pilot enablement within 2 weeks" once flag exists?
Shankar (Eng): Yes, once flag + minimal infra isolation are in place we can onboard pilots in ~10 business days. Need SE help for tenant onboarding doc.
Anya (PM): Action items: 
- Anya: update roadmap/priorities doc and public MVP one-pager to remove public SSO + advanced routing (due EOD).
- Shankar: add feature flag, rollout plan, and rollback steps to the launch checklist (PR by Thu).
- Jules: provide fallback UX copy + banner mock (tomorrow morning).
- Micah: communicate pilot compromise to customers and collect acceptance (by Fri).
- Carla: update marketing blurbs and helpcenter note (by next Tue).
Shankar (Eng): Also adding: quantify perf delta from caching change so we can move it earlier if we get extra cycles.
Anya (PM): Agreed. If perf numbers improve, we can re-evaluate and lift holdback earlier.
Jules (Design): Quick Q — do we want a visible "Enterprise pilot" badge in the Console for tenants with SSO enabled? That helps SEs spot them.
Micah (Sales): Yes please, that’ll make support handoffs easier.
Shankar (Eng): I’ll add a lightweight tenant flag in the Console UI data returned by the API; design can wire it to the badge.
Carla (PMM): +:thumbsup: Good compromise. Keeps MVP focused but preserves a path for revenue-driving pilots.
release-bot: Canary for "public-mvp/v1" started on 5% of regions — monitor latency and error-rate dashboards.
Anya (PM): Closing note — we’ll reconvene next Tue 11am for a short checkpoint (status on feature flag PR, pilot comms, and metrics). If any customer blows up on SSO as a hard blocker, we can escalate.
Micah (Sales): I’ll flag any escalations immediately.
Shankar (Eng): Will post the PR link and rollout sheet here when ready.
Anya (PM): Thanks all — sounds like plan. :white_check_mark:
